messages:
Jordan (Sales): Heads up — customer (gov org) asked for an island deployment POC in an air-gapped datacenter. They want a 4-week POC, no egress, HSM-backed keys, and a clear upgrade cadence + pricing. Any immediate blockers?
Anya (Solutions Eng): Quick clarifying q's — HSM type? Yubi/HSM appliance or cloud HSM emulation? Also how do they want bundles delivered (USB, signed ISO, or on-prem registry)?
Jordan (Sales): They specified hardware HSM (Thales/YubiHSM), no cloud. Delivery via USB or courier is fine. They also asked if we can do delta patches (not full bundle every time).
Michael (SRE): Short answer: yes on all. We produce a signed detached bundle + signed delta patches. Typical base quantized model bundle (8-bit) for medium LLM ~8GB; deltas usually 20–300MB depending on change.
Anya (Solutions Eng): Ops notes: offline activation supports signed JWT token workflow. We validate signature w/ customer-provided CA. Need to include sha256 checksums and signed manifest. Example install snippet:```bash
# on customer bastion
curl --progress --data-binary @bundle.tar.gz 
  -H "X-RW-Signature: <sig>" 
  -H "X-RW-Manifest: manifest.json" 
  -o /opt/redwood/bundle.tar.gz
sha256sum /opt/redwood/bundle.tar.gz | grep <expected-sha256>
# then run bootstrap
./rwdctl bootstrap --bundle /opt/redwood/bundle.tar.gz --activation-token activation.jwt
```
Priya (AE): Pricing guidance for presales: standard on-prem POC package = $25k professional services (4 weeks) + $5k one-time packaging/signing fee. HSM integration +3–10k depending on support level. If they convert to Dedicated, credit the PS fee.
Jordan (Sales): Customer also sent security questionnaire (50 items). Which items usually trip us up?
Security (Legal): Common flags: telemetry (must be opt-out), SBOM for all artifacts, signing key provenance, third-party deps vulnerability policy, indemnity for data exfiltration when offline, and retention policies. We'll need to complete the questionnaire but can pre-fill most with 'no telemetry, local-only by default, offline verification via signed manifests'.
Michael (SRE): One enterprise blocker to call out: CVE remediation timelines in fully air-gapped envs. Our standard SLA assumes ability to push hotfixes; air-gapped customers must allow physical patch windows (we recommend quarterly security patch windows + emergency signed hotfix process). Legal sometimes wants <30d remediation — that can be problematic offline.
Anya (Solutions Eng): Another ops detail: cert rotation in offline mode — we provide an operator CLI: `rwdctl cert rotate --source usb --root-ca /mnt/usb/root.crt`. We also can provide a small runbook for manual rollback.
DevOps Bot: Detached bundle v1.2 signed (ed25519) and manifest generated: manifest-v1.2.json (internal-only).
Priya (AE): Ask for customer: confirm who will hold the root CA and who signs activation tokens. Also confirm number of nodes (they mentioned 3 min) and expected qps/seq len (Jordan pls confirm).
Jordan (Sales): I'll confirm nodes (they said 3) and target ~200 TPS for short sequences. I'll also ask who will hold the CA.
Security (Legal): I'll start a template reply for the sec questionnaire and attach SBOM + signing process. Flagging indemnity and SLA deviation for offline patching — need SM/AM signoff.
Anya (Solutions Eng): Next concrete deliverables: 1) short runbook + install checklist for courier delivery, 2) security-questionnaire draft answers, 3) POC pricing line-itemization, 4) USB/delta patch acceptance test plan. I can draft runbook by EOD.
Jordan (Sales): Perfect — can we aim to send the POC package proposal + sec answers by Tuesday COB? Customer requested a kickoff early next week.
Priya (AE): Tuesday COB works if legal has sec answers by Monday noon. I'll tentatively reserve PS calendar slots.
Michael (SRE): I'll add a short note about emergency hotfix process and offline validation steps to the runbook.
Jordan (Sales): Thanks team — I'll update customer and schedule kick-off Mon 10am PT. Will @mention as soon as they confirm. :thumbsup:
